business_semantics.typed_obligations: Single task definition with exact original-source citations; lowers state, transaction, answer, query report, communication and process obligations through existing compiler primitives.
business_semantics.temporal_completion: Explicit fixed eligibility time; reset world and scheduled external events determine scope; actual commit clock determines effects. Delay cannot waive an initially available duty.
business_semantics.preserved: Explicit refusal/revocation, real commit requirement, full-world comparison and independent source interpretation.
limits: Citations do not prove correct business interpretation.
Fixed-time counterfactual scope is not a universal temporal policy; other policies retain explicit goals.
No model adoption/full delivery claim from unit tests.

evidence_reuse.transport: Manifest-bound ledger exported with bundle; restored in container-check and training adapter.
evidence_reuse.identity: Model, recursive Python implementation, complete semantic payload and schema.
evidence_reuse.fresh_review: Always calls model; conflicting judgments poison the dependency.

native_validation.revision_note: Native reuse proof preceded the subsequent shared-event refactor; final regression covers the combined implementation, no full pipeline timing claim.

cross_scenario_validation: Direct, simple, retrieval, long chain, ordinary transaction and complex transaction lowering preserve compiled identities.
Initial obligation expiry, future eligibility, scheduled event, unavailable target, explicit refusal/revocation, commit followed by wait, forged lifecycle and invalid tick-based anchor.
Existing full regression preserves atomicity, partial transactions, privacy and training continuation.

next_measurement.default: independent new-business assets, reviews and freeze before execution

implementation_consolidation: Runtime external events, temporal projection and anchored scope use one pure world-event interpreter.
Typed obligation lowering occurs once per definition compile.
